# GradeSaver

> > GradeSaver provides comprehensive study guides, character analyses, plot summaries, and Q&A resources for classic and contemporary literature and film.

GradeSaver offers detailed academic resources for students and educators studying works ranging from Swift's Gulliver's Travels and Orwell's Animal Farm to modern films like Dead Poets Society and Avatar. The site features expert-written study guides, character lists, literary analysis, and community-driven question-and-answer forums.

## Key Topics

- Literary analysis
- Character analysis
- Plot summaries
- Study guides
- Satire
- Classic literature
- Film analysis
- Gulliver's Travels
- Animal Farm
- Dead Poets Society
- Four voyages narrative
- Lilliputians and Houyhnhnms
- Adventure narratives
- Literary characters
- Educational resources

## Literature Study Guides

- [Gulliver's Travels Summary](https://www.gradesaver.com/gullivers-travels/study-guide/summary): Complete plot summary of Swift's Gulliver's Travels covering all voyages

## Film Study Guides

- [Dead Poets Society Characters](https://www.gradesaver.com/dead-poets-society/study-guide/character-list): Character analysis for Dead Poets Society including Mr. Keating
- [Alice in Wonderland (2010 film) Characters](https://www.gradesaver.com/alice-in-wonderland-2010-film/study-guide/character-list): Character guide for Burton's 2010 Alice in Wonderland film adaptation
- [Avatar Characters](https://www.gradesaver.com/avatar/study-guide/character-list): Character list for Cameron's Avatar including Jake Sully and Na'vi

## Community Q&A

- [Animal Farm: Review of Related Literature](https://www.gradesaver.com/animal-farm/q-and-a/review-of-related-literature-324666): Student Q&A about Animal Farm thesis on class division effects
- [Animal Farm: Rebellion Motives](https://www.gradesaver.com/animal-farm/q-and-a/what-was-their-motive-for-rebellion-66925): Q&A on Animal Farm rebellion motives from chapters 1-2
